items.title: REPLACING A HAND-ROLLED HYPOTHESIS BY 'THE STANDARD ONE' CAN STRENGTHEN IT INTO FALSITY -- and the test is a REFUTATION probe at the intended object, not a satisfiability witness.
AN 'ONLY PRODUCER IS FIELD-ONLY' CLAIM IS A CENSUS OF THE NAME YOU GUESSED, AND THE RING-LEVEL VERSION IS OFTEN LANDED UNDER A DIFFERENT MAP.
A "TRAP, MEASURED -- DO NOT ROUTE VIA X" NOTE IS THE HIGHEST-LEVERAGE FALSE CLAIM A LANE CAN SHIP, AND THE CHEAPEST TEST IS TO GREP WHETHER A SIBLING FILE ALREADY DOES X.
A LOCALISATION REDUCTION IS EMPTIED BY THE CONSUMER OWN OUTER QUANTIFIER, AND EVERY PER-STATEMENT CHECK PASSES.
A --summary WRITE IS A SILENT DESTRUCTIVE EDIT, AND THE TOOL'S OWN OUTPUT CANNOT SHOW IT. Check the commit STAT, not the command's success line.
A THREE-LANE COMPOSITION IS INVISIBLE TO EVERY PER-ROW CHECK, AND THE ROWS WILL EACH TELL YOU THE WORK IS ELSEWHERE.
VANISHING-VOCABULARY SPELLINGS ARE ONE ANTECEDENT -- and the commit that ships the 'reduced' producer often ships the iff that proves it is a re-spelling.
